title: Normal 1, scRNAseq
characteristics_ch1.2: cell type: peripheral blood mononuclear cell
growth_protocol_ch1: Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells (PBMCs) in the blood samples were obtained from normal individuals and PD patients.
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMCs were purified by Ficoll gradient separation, according to the instructions of the manufacturer (Ficoll–PaqueTM Plus, GE Healthcare, Sweden). In short, 3 mL of Ficoll-Paque gradient was pipetted into two 15-ml centrifuge tubes. The blood was diluted with a ratio 1:1 in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) and carefully layered over the Ficoll-Paque gradient. The tubes were centrifuged for 30 min at 400 × g. The cell interface layer was harvested carefully (8 ml/tube), and the cells were washed twice in PBS (for 10 min at 100 × g). PBMCs were resuspended in 1 mL complete culture medium (DMEM medium supplemented with 10 % newborn calf serum, 1 % PS).
extract_protocol_ch1.1: RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using standard Illumina protocols
data_processing: The demultiplexing, barcoded processing, gene counting and aggregation were made using the Cell Ranger software v2.2.0 (https://support.10xgenomics.com/single-cell-gene-expression/software/pipelines/latest/what-is-cell-ranger)
data_processing.2: Supplementary files format and content: Tab-separated values files and matrix files
